title: Saludos y presentaciones
summary: A fictional first lesson: greetings, saying your name, and asking how someone is. Demo content only — not a real class.
article_md:
## Takeaway

Use **hola** any time of day. **Buenos días / buenas tardes / buenas noches** follow the clock.

## Rules

**Tú vs usted.** Friends and classmates take *tú*. Formal situations take *usted*.

- Hola, ¿cómo estás? (informal)
- Buenos días, ¿cómo está usted? (formal)

## Useful chunks

- Me llamo Alex.
- Mucho gusto.
- Igualmente.

vocabulary.example_learner: Nice to meet you, I am Alex.

grammar.rule: Tú is informal; usted is formal.

quotes.speaker: teacher
quotes.gloss: You can always start with hola.
